# Outputs

This folder contains committed demo results plus files generated when the end-to-end pipeline is run.

## Committed portfolio outputs

- `model_metrics.json` — comparison of Linear Regression, Decision Tree, and Random Forest on the committed demo transfer data using a 2025 time-based test split.
- `transition_summary.csv` — average pre/post PPG, TS%, and Player ORtg by transition type such as Low → High and Medium → High.
- `screenshots/` — seven EDA and team-profile visuals shown in the main README.

## Generated by `python run_pipeline.py`

### Data-cleaning outputs
- `team_seasons_clean.csv`
- `player_seasons_clean.csv`
- `transfers_clean.csv`
- `data_quality_summary.csv`

### EDA outputs
- `eda_offensive_rating_distribution.png`
- `eda_offense_vs_defense.png`
- `eda_net_rating_by_season.png`
- `eda_team_metric_correlation.png`
- `eda_player_ppg_boxplot.png`
- `eda_pre_vs_post_ppg.png`

### Modeling outputs
- `team_profiles.csv`
- `transfer_modeling_table.csv`
- `model_metrics.json`
- `transition_summary.csv`
- `model_bundle.joblib` (ignored by Git)

### Model/decision-support charts
- `team_profiles.png`
- `transition_analysis.png`
- `model_comparison.png`
- `feature_importance.png`

The committed results are demonstration results from synthetic NCAA-like data. They show how the workflow operates; they should not be interpreted as validated NCAA recruiting accuracy until the same pipeline is retrained and tested on real historical data.
